_about: Whitelist Screener settings, mirroring the team's Excel. weights = default % per parameter (the screen lets each viewer adjust them live; a parameter's weight is shared equally by its horizons/periods). ratio_horizons = windows every ratio is measured over. return_periods = trailing returns scored. min_history = funds younger than this are listed as newly launched and not ranked. scoring = minmax (house method) or percentile. bear_periods = market falls used for Max Drawdown and Recovery Time: edit, add or remove freely (YYYY-MM-DD, start = market peak, end = market low); seeded from NIFTY 50 falls of 10% or more since 2015. active_share_index = the index whose constituents count as common stocks.
